verses.geez: ወውእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ደወየ፡ ሕዝቅያስ፡ ወበጽሐ፡ ለሞት።
verses.translation: And it came to pass at that time, that Ezekias was sick even to death. And Esaias the prophet the son of Amos came to him, and said to him, Thus saith the Lord, Give orders concerning thy house: for thou shalt die, and not live.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass at that time, that Ezekias was sick even to death. And Esaias the prophet the son of Amos came to him, and said to him, Thus saith the Lord, Give orders concerning thy house: for thou shalt die, and not live.
translations.kjv: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.
translations.ron: În vremea aceea Iezechia s-a îmbolnăvit de moarte. Şi a intrat la el Isaia, fiul lui Amos, şi i-a zis: "Aşa grăieşte Domnul: Pune rânduială în casa ta, că nu vei mai trăi, ci vei muri".
translations.grk: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ, ἐμαλακίσθη Ἐζεκίας ἕως θανάτου· καὶ ἦλθε πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἡσαΐας υἱὸς Ἀμὼς ὁ προφήτης, καὶ εἶπε πρὸς αὐτὸν, τάδε λέγει Κύριος, τάξαι περὶ τοῦ οἴκου σου, ἀποθνήσκεις γὰρ σὺ, καὶ οὐ ζήσῃ.

verses.geez: ወሜጠ፡ ሕዝቅያስ፡ ገጾ፡ ኀበ፡ አረፍት፡ ወጸለየ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: And Ezekias turned his face to the wall, and prayed to the Lord, saying,

translations.lxx: And Ezekias turned his face to the wall, and prayed to the Lord, saying,
translations.kjv: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the LORD,
translations.ron: Atunci s-a întors Iezechia cu faţa la perete şi s-a rugat Domnului:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Ἐζεκίας τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸν τεῖχον, καὶ προσηύξατο πρὸς Κύριον,

verses.geez: ወይቤ፤ ተዘከር፡ እግዚኦ፡ ዘከመ፡ ሖርኩ፡ ቅድሜከ፡ በጽድቅ፡ ወበልብ፡ ርቱዕ፣፡ ወገበርኩ፡ ቅድሜከ፡ ሥምረተከ።
verses.translation: Remember, O Lord, how I have walked before thee in truth, with a true heart, and have done that which was pleasing in thy sight. And Ezekias wept bitterly.

translations.lxx: Remember, O Lord, how I have walked before thee in truth, with a true heart, and have done that which was pleasing in thy sight. And Ezekias wept bitterly.
translations.kjv: And said, Remember now, O LORD, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
translations.ron: "O, Doamne! Adu-ţi aminte că am umblat înaintea Ta întru credincioşie şi cu inimă curată, săvârşind ceea ce este plăcut înaintea ochilor Tăi!" Şi a izbucnit Iezechia în hohote de plâns.
translations.grk: λέγων, μνήσθητι Κύριε, ὡς ἐπορεύθην ἐνώπιόν σου μετὰ ἀληθείας, ἐν καρδίᾳ ἀληθινῇ, καὶ τὰ ἀρεστὰ ἐνώπιόν σου ἐποίησα· καὶ ἔκλαυσεν Ἐζεκίας κλαυθμῷ μεγάλῳ.

verses.geez: ወኮነ፡ ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኀበ፡ ኢሳይያስ፡ ወይቤሎ።
verses.translation: And the word of the Lord came to Esaias, saying, Go, and say to Ezekias,

translations.lxx: And the word of the Lord came to Esaias, saying, Go, and say to Ezekias,
translations.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD to Isaiah, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a fost cuvântul Domnului către Isaia, zicând:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς Ἡσαΐαν, λέγων,

verses.geez: ሖር፡ በሎ፡ ለሕዝቅያስ፤ ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላኩ፡ ለዳዊት፡ አቡከ፤ ሰማዕኩአ፡ ጸሎተከ፡ ወርኢኩአ፡ አንብዐከ፤ ወናሁ፡ ወሰኩከ፡ በዲበ፡ ዓመታቲከ፡ ዐሠርተ፡ ወኃምስተ፡ ዓመተ።
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, and seen thy tears: behold, I will add to thy time fifteen years.

translations.lxx: Thus saith the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, and seen thy tears: behold, I will add to thy time fifteen years.
translations.kjv: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.
translations.ron: "Du-te şi spune lui Iezechia: Aşa grăieşte Domnul Dumnezeul lui David, tatăl tău: Ascultat-am rugăciunea ta, văzut-am lacrimile tale, iată voi adăuga la viaţa ta încă cincisprezece ani
translations.grk: πορεύθητι, καὶ εἰπὸν Ἐζεκίᾳ, τάδε λέγει Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς Δαυὶδ τοῦ πατρός σου, ἤκουσα τῆς προσευχῆς σου, καὶ εἶδον τὰ δάκρυά σου· ἰδοὺ προστίθημι πρὸς τὸν χρόνον σου δεκαπέντε ἔτη,

verses.geez: ወአድኅነከ፡ እምእዴሆሙ፡ ለነገሥተ፡ ፋርስ፡ ወእቀውም፡ ላቲ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ሀገር።
verses.translation: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of the Assyrians: and I will defend this city.

translations.lxx: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of the Assyrians: and I will defend this city.
translations.kjv: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.
translations.ron: Şi din mâna regelui Asiriei te voi izbăvi pe tine şi cetatea aceasta şi o voi ocroti".
translations.grk: καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων ῥύσομαί σε καὶ τὴν πόλιν ταύτην, καὶ ὑπερασπιῶ ὑπὲρ τῆς πόλεως ταύτης.

verses.geez: ወዝንቱ፡ ትእምርቱ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ከመ፡ ይግበር፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘንተ፡ ነገረ።
verses.translation: And this shall be a sign to thee from the Lord, that God will do this thing;

translations.lxx: And this shall be a sign to thee from the Lord, that God will do this thing;
translations.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he hath spoken;
translations.ron: Şi iată semnul care ţi se va da fie de la Domnul că El Îşi va împlini cuvântul Său:
translations.grk: Τοῦτο δέ σοι τὸ σημεῖον παρὰ Κυρίου, ὅτι ποιήσει ὁ Θεὸς τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο·

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ አነ፡ እመይጥ፡ ጽላሎተ፡ መዓርጋት፡ ወሪዶ፡ ዲበ፡ ዐሠርቱ፡ መዓርጋት፡ ዘቤተ፡ አቡከ፤ ወይገብእ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ዲበ፡ መዓርጋት፡ ዐሠርቱ፤ ወየዐርግ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ዲበ፡ ዐሠርቱ፡ መዓርጋት፡ ኀበ፡ ወረደ፡ ዝኩ፡ ጽኩ፡ ጽላሎት።
verses.translation: behold, I will turn back the shadow of the degrees of the dial by which ten degrees on the house of thy father the sun has gone down—I will turn back the sun the ten degrees; so the sun went back the ten degrees by which the shadow had gone down.

translations.lxx: behold, I will turn back the shadow of the degrees of the dial by which ten degrees on the house of thy father the sun has gone down—I will turn back the sun the ten degrees; so the sun went back the ten degrees by which the shadow had gone down.
translations.kjv: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
translations.ron: "Iată voi întoarce umbra cu atâtea linii pe care soarele le-a străbătut pe ceasornicul lui Ahaz, să zic cu zece linii". Şi soarele s-a dat înapoi cu zece linii pe care el le străbătuse.
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ στρέφω τὴν σκιὰν τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν οὓς κατέβη τοὺς δέκα ἀναβαθμοὺς τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ πατρός σου ὁ ἥλιος, ἀποστρέψω τὸν ἥλιον τοὺς δέκα ἀναβαθμούς· καὶ ἀνέβη ὁ ἥλιος τοὺς δέκα ἀναβαθμοὺς, οὓς κατέβη ἡ σκιά.

verses.geez: አንሰ፡ እቤ፡ በኑኃ፡ መዋዕልየ፤ ውስተ፡ አናቅጸ፡ ሲኦል፡ አሐውር፤ ወአኀድግ፡ ዘተረፈ፡ ዓመታትየ።
verses.translation: The Prayer of Ezekias king of Judea, when he had been sick, and was recovered from his sickness.

translations.lxx: The Prayer of Ezekias king of Judea, when he had been sick, and was recovered from his sickness.
translations.kjv: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:
translations.ron: Rugăciunea lui Iezechia, regele lui Iuda, când a căzut bolnav şi s-a tămăduit de boala lui:
translations.grk: ΠΡΟΣΕΥΧΗ ἘΖΕΚΙΟΥ ΒΑΣΙΛΕΩΣ ΤΗΣ ἸΟΥΔΑΙΑΣ, ἩΝΙΚΑ ἘΜΑΛΑΚΙΣΘΗ, ΚΑΙ ἈΝΕΣΤΗ ἘΚ ΤΗΣ ΜΑΛΑΚΙΑΣ ΑΥΤΟΥ.

verses.geez: ወእቤ፤ ኢይሬኢ፡ እንከ፡ መድኃኒተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በምድረ፡ ሕያዋን፤ ወኢይሬኢ፡ እንከ፡ ሰብአ።
verses.translation: I said in the end of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I shall part with the remainder of my years.

translations.lxx: I said in the end of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I shall part with the remainder of my years.
translations.kjv: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
translations.ron: "Atunci eu am zis: Mă duc la amiaza zilelor mele, la porţile locuinţei morţilor voi fi ţinut pentru restul anilor mei.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ εἶπα ἐν τῷ ὕψει τῶν ἡμερῶν μου, πορεύσομαι ἐν πύλαις ἅδου, καταλείψω τὰ ἔτη τὰ ἐπίλοιπα.

verses.geez: ኀልቀ፡ እምአዝማድየ፡ ወሐጐልኩ፡ ዘተረፈ፡ ሕይወትየ፤ ወፅአት፡ ወኀለፈት፡ እምኔየ፤ ከመ፡ ዘይተክል፡ ወይሥዕር፡ ደብተራሁ፤ ከማሁ፡ ኮነት፡ ነፍስየ፡ በላዕሌየ፡ ከመ፡ ዕጡፈ፡ ፀምር፡ ዘአልጸቀ፡ ይግምድዎ።
verses.translation: I said, I shall no more at all see the salvation of God in the land of the living: I shall no more at all see the salvation of Israel on the earth: I shall no more at all see man.

translations.lxx: I said, I shall no more at all see the salvation of God in the land of the living: I shall no more at all see the salvation of Israel on the earth: I shall no more at all see man.
translations.kjv: I said, I shall not see the LORD, even the LORD, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
translations.ron: Nu voi mai vedea pe Domnul în pământul celor vii; şi nu voi mai privi pe nimeni dintre locuitorii lumii.
translations.grk: Εἶπα, οὐκέτι οὐ μὴ ἴδω τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπὶ γῆς ζώντων, οὐκέτι μὴ ἴδω τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ἐπὶ γῆς, οὐκέτι μὴ ἴδω ἄνθρωπον.

verses.geez: ውእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ተሀወኩ፡ ከመ፡ አንበሳ፡ እስከ፡ ይጸብሕ፤ ከማሁ፡ ተቀጥቀጣኒ፡ አዕፅምትየ፤ አኀዘኒ፡ እምነግህ፡ እስከ፡ ሰርክ።
verses.translation: My life has failed from among my kindred: I have parted with the remainder of my life: it has gone forth and departed from me, as one that having pitched a tent takes it down again: my breath was with me as a weaver's web, when she that weaves draws nigh to cut off the thread.

translations.lxx: My life has failed from among my kindred: I have parted with the remainder of my life: it has gone forth and departed from me, as one that having pitched a tent takes it down again: my breath was with me as a weaver's web, when she that weaves draws nigh to cut off the thread.
translations.kjv: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd’s tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
translations.ron: Casa mea este smulsă şi dusă departe de mine, ca o colibă de ciobani. Îmi simt firul vieţii tăiat ca de un ţesător care m-ar rupe din ţesătura lui. De dimineaţă până seara, Tu ai sfârşit cu mine.
translations.grk: Ἐξέλιπεν ἐκ τῆς συγγενείας μου, κατέλιπον τὸ ἐπίλοιπον τῆς ζωῆς μου, ἐξῆλθε καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ ὥσπερ ὁ σκηνὴν καταλύων πήξας· ὡς ἱστὸς τὸ πνεῦμά μου παρʼ ἐμοὶ ἐγένετο, ἐρίθου ἐγγιζούσης ἐκτεμεῖν.

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ማዕነቅ፡ ከማሁ፡ እነቁ፣፡ ወከመ፡ ርግብ፡ ከማሁ፡ እነብብ።
verses.translation: In that day I was given up as to a lion until the morning: so has he broken all my bones: for I was so given up from day even to night.

translations.lxx: In that day I was given up as to a lion until the morning: so has he broken all my bones: for I was so given up from day even to night.
translations.kjv: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
translations.ron: Strig până dimineaţa. Ca un leu (boala) îmi sfărâmă oasele mele! De dimineaţă până seara, Tu ai sfârşit cu mine.
translations.grk: Ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ παρεδόθην ἕως πρωῒ ὡς λέοντι, οὕτως συνέτριψε πάντα τὰ ὀστᾶ μου· ἀπὸ γὰρ τῆς ἡμέρας ἕως νυκτὸς παρεδόθην.

verses.geez: እግዚኦ፡ በእንቲአሃ፡ እቤለከ፡ ወአንሣእካ፡ ለነፍስየ፤ ወተፈሣሕኩ፡ ወሐየውኩ።
verses.translation: As a swallow, so will I cry, and as a dove, so do I mourn: for mine eyes have failed with looking to the height of heaven to the Lord, who has delivered me,

translations.lxx: As a swallow, so will I cry, and as a dove, so do I mourn: for mine eyes have failed with looking to the height of heaven to the Lord, who has delivered me,
translations.kjv: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O LORD, I am oppressed; undertake for me.
translations.ron: ţip cumplit ca o rândunică, gem ca o porumbiţă. Ochii mei slăbesc, uitându-se în sus. Doamne, sunt în mare cumpănă, nu mă lăsa!
translations.grk: Ὡς χελιδὼν, οὕτω φωνήσω, καὶ ὡς περιστερὰ, οὕτω μελετῶ· ἐξέλιπον γάρ μου οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ τοῦ βλέπειν εἰς τὸ ὕψος τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πρὸς τὸν Κύριον, ὃς ἐξείλατό με,

verses.geez: ወተሠሀልካ፡ ለነፍስየ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትትሐጐል፤ ወገደፍከ፡ ድኅሬየ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኃጢአትየ።
verses.translation: and removed the sorrow of my soul.

translations.lxx: and removed the sorrow of my soul.
translations.kjv: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
translations.ron: Ce să mai grăiesc! El mi-a dat de ştire şi a făcut! Sfârşi-voi firul vieţii mele, aducându-mi aminte de amărăciunea sufletului meu!
translations.grk: καὶ ἀφείλατό μου τὴν ὀδύνην τῆς ψυχῆς.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አኮ፡ እለ፡ ውስተ፡ ሲኦል፡ ዘይሴብሑከ፡ ወአኮ፡ እለ፡ ይመውቱ፡ ዘይባርኩከ፤ ወኢይሴፈው፡ ሣህለከ፡ እለ፡ ውስተ፡ ሲኦል።
verses.translation: Yea, O Lord, for it was told thee concerning this; and thou hast revived my breath; and I am comforted, and live.

translations.lxx: Yea, O Lord, for it was told thee concerning this; and thou hast revived my breath; and I am comforted, and live.
translations.kjv: O LORD, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.
translations.ron: Doamne, prin îndurarea Ta se bucură omul de viaţă, prin ea mai am şi eu suflare; Tu mă tămăduieşti şi-mi dai iarăşi viaţă!
translations.grk: Κύριε, περὶ αὐτῆς γὰρ ἀνηγγέλη σοι, καὶ ἐξήγειράς μου τὴν πνοὴν, καὶ παρακληθεὶς ἔζησα.

verses.geez: ዳእሙ፡ ሕያዋን፡ ይባርኩከ፡ በከመ፡ አነ።
verses.translation: For thou hast chosen my soul, that it should not perish: and thou hast cast all my sins behind me.

translations.lxx: For thou hast chosen my soul, that it should not perish: and thou hast cast all my sins behind me.
translations.kjv: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
translations.ron: Iată că boala mea se schimbă în sănătate. Tu ai păzit viaţa mea de adâncul mistuitor! Tu ai aruncat înapoia Ta toate păcatele mele!
translations.grk: Εἵλου γάρ μου τὴν ψυχὴν, ἴνα μὴ ἀπόληται, καὶ ἀπέῤῥιψας ὀπίσω μου πάσας τὰς ἁμαρτίας.

verses.geez: እግዚእየ፡ ወመድኃንየ፡ አንተ፣፡ ወአነሂ፡ ኢየኀድግ፡ ባርኮተከ፤ በመዝሙር፡ በኵሉ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሕይወትየ፡ በቅድመ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: For they that are in the grave shall not praise thee, neither shall the dead bless thee, neither shall they that are in Hades hope for thy mercy.

translations.lxx: For they that are in the grave shall not praise thee, neither shall the dead bless thee, neither shall they that are in Hades hope for thy mercy.
translations.kjv: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
translations.ron: Că locuinţa morţilor nu Te va lăuda şi moartea nu Te va preaslăvi; cei ce se coboară în mormânt nu mai nădăjduiesc în credincioşia Ta.
translations.grk: Οὐ γὰρ οἱ ἐν ᾅδου αἰνέσουσί σε, οὐδὲ οἱ ἀποθανόντες εὐλογήσουσί σε, οὐδὲ ἐλπιοῦσιν οἱ ἐν ᾄδου τὴν ἐλεημοσύνην σου.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ኢሳይያስ፡ ለሕዝቅያስ፤ ንሣእ፡ ዐጽቀ፡ በለስ፡ ወሕርፅ፡ ወተቀባእ፡ ወተሐዩ።
verses.translation: The living shall bless thee, as I also do: for from this day shall I beget children, who shall declare thy righteousness,

translations.lxx: The living shall bless thee, as I also do: for from this day shall I beget children, who shall declare thy righteousness,
translations.kjv: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.
translations.ron: Cel viu, cel viu Te laudă, ca mine astăzi; părinţii învaţă pe copiii lor credincioşia Ta.
translations.grk: Οἱ ζῶντες εὐλογήσουσί σε ὃν τρόπον κᾀγώ· ἀπὸ γὰρ τῆς σήμερον παιδία ποιήσω, ἅ ἀναγγελοῦσι τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου

verses.geez: ወይቤ፡ ሕዝቅያስ፤ ዝንቱኑ፡ ትእምርቱ፡ ከመ፡ አዕርግ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: O God of my salvation; and I will not cease blessing thee with the psaltery all the days of my life before the house of God.

translations.lxx: O God of my salvation; and I will not cease blessing thee with the psaltery all the days of my life before the house of God.
translations.kjv: The LORD was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD.
translations.ron: Domnul să ne mântuiască şi vom cânta din harpă în toate zilele vieţii noastre înaintea templului Domnului!"
translations.grk: Θεὲ τῆς σωτηρίας μου, καὶ οὐ παύσομαι εὐλογῶν σε μετὰ ψαλτηρίου πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς μου, κατέναντι τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ Θεοῦ.
